风格描述-中文: 侵略性强，善于撕开对手最后层防线的前锋。
风格描述-英文: A predatory striker who plays off the shoulders of the last defender.

风格描述-中文: 吸引对手后卫，为其他球员创造空档的球员。
风格描述-英文: A player who attracts the defence to create space for other players to exploit.

风格描述-中文: 在禁区内隐藏，等待机会的前锋。
风格描述-英文: A striker who lurks in the opposition 18 yard box just waiting for the ball.

风格描述-中文: 将自己定位成在锋线的一名站桩式中锋，并以身体保护球的球员。
风格描述-英文: A player that positions himself on the frontlines as a target man, and protects the ball with his physique.

风格描述-中文: 愿意回撤接球并帮助创造进攻机会的前锋球员。
风格描述-英文: A forward player that is willing to fall back to receive the ball and help create plays.

风格描述-英文: A player who takes advantage of any opening in the defence to initiate attacks and assists to shots on goal.

风格描述-中文: 站在侧翼位置接收传球的球员，当机会出现时，偶尔也会切入中心。
风格描述-英文: A player who positions himself on the wing to receive passes, occasionally cutting into the centre when the opportunity arises.

风格描述-中文: 倾向于从侧翼切入以接球的球员。
风格描述-英文: A player who tends to cut inside from the wing to receive passes.

风格描述-中文: 在边线伺机横传的球员。
风格描述-英文: A player who hugs the touchline, waiting for a chance to cross the ball in.

风格描述-中文: 保持高位站位，方便发起攻势，伺机前插参与射门。
风格描述-英文: Takes a high position to initiate attacks and also goes for goal themselves when the chance arises.

风格描述-中文: 有很大进攻欲望，一有机会就往前寻求射门的球员。
风格描述-英文: A player who looks to make runs into the opposition goal area when the team is on the attack.

风格描述-中文: 整场比赛不懈奔跑，覆盖整个球场的球员。
风格描述-英文: A player who tirelessly covers every blade of grass for the full 90 minutes.

风格描述-英文: A deep sitting defensive midfielder protecting the backline.

风格描述-中文: 潜伏在更深的位置准备发起进攻的球员。
风格描述-英文: A player who lurks in deeper positions, ready to initiate attacks.

风格描述-中文: 从较深位置参与进攻组织。
风格描述-英文: From a deep position, takes part in setting up attacks.

风格描述-中文: 喜欢参与进攻，并争取每个机会围攻对手球门的后卫。
风格描述-英文: A defender who likes to join in the attack and lay siege on the opposition goal at every given opportunity.

风格描述-中文: 一有机会就跑向前场参与进攻的进攻型后卫。
风格描述-英文: An attack-minded full-back who will run upfield and join the attack when presented with a chance.

风格描述-中文: 喜欢留在后场执行防守任务的可靠后卫。
风格描述-英文: A solid full-back who prefers to stay back and stick to defensive duties.

风格描述-中文: 喜欢介入中心区进攻的进攻型后卫。
风格描述-英文: An attacking full-back who enjoys joining the attack in high central areas.

风格描述-中文: 进攻时保持高位站位，覆盖防线后方区域遏制反击。
风格描述-英文: Takes a high position when attacking, covering the area behind the defence to thwart counter attacks.

风格描述-中文: 从锋线开始对门将及后卫实施高位压迫。
风格描述-英文: Presses the opposing keeper and defenders aggressively from the top of the front line.

风格描述-中文: 预判对方传球路线并占据有利位置。
风格描述-英文: Watches the opponent's passing lanes and takes up smart positions.

风格描述-中文: 根据局势保留体力、避免回防，始终在前场待机进攻。
风格描述-英文: Avoids defending to save energy depending on the situation and remains up front waiting to attack.

风格描述-中文: 球队防守时积极回撤补位，应对对方攻势。
风格描述-英文: Runs back aggressively when the team is defending and responds to the opponent's attacks.

风格描述-中文: 主动封堵对方传球路线进行防守。
风格描述-英文: Defends by actively blocking the opponent's passing lanes.

风格描述-英文: Applies pressure aggressively when close to an opponent who has the ball.

风格描述-中文: 主动补位进行逼迫的队友。
风格描述-英文: Actively covers for teammates conducting Match-up roles.

风格描述-中文: 专注于保持高效防守阵型，确保防守时整体架构稳固。
风格描述-英文: Looks to maintain an effective defensive line, keeping the shape intact as they defend.

风格描述-中文: 果断出击封锁射门角度，应对传到防线后方的球。
风格描述-英文: Comes out aggressively to limit shooting angles and respond to balls sent behind the defence.

风格描述-中文: 固守球门附近区域，避免贸然出击。
风格描述-英文: Holds a position near the goal and refrains from rushing out aggressively.

风格描述-英文: Takes a high position and rushes out aggressively to cover a wide area behind the defence.
